Message:
I quickly headed in the direction
the squirrels had run from.
But...

A flock of birds were
collapsed on the ground,
their bodies pierced by
sharpened sticks.

When I turned around
to see the source of
the unfamiliar voice...

an animal I had never
seen before was there.
But, I recognized
their appearance instantly...

They had no wings or beak...
and had the same body as me...

No... I had known all along...
That I wasn’t really
Mother’s child...

I had just wanted to be
Mother’s daughter so badly,
I refused to ever question it...

But of all things...
to think I would be the same
as such a cruel animal as this...!

I saw the animal aim a stick
towards me and shoot it...
then felt something
graze my cheek...

This is the stick that
killed those birds...!
At this rate, I’ll also be...!

The animal then
aimed for my head,
and another sharpened stick
flew into the air...
But, just as I squeezed
my eyes shut...
